claimLevel: DEVICE_MEASURED (placement: each point was pressed on the handset and the next native SNAP showed the named effect, sessions f3-ex1/f3-ex2 on 2026-09-25); timings are not claimed here beyond the pan floor Plan 26 measured

view.pan: The office is 2000 px wide in a 1024 window and a night starts panned fully left. A hold at the right edge pans right and saturates at 968 px in 1025 ms (5/5; 1000 ms 2/5, Plan 26); holds here are 1100 ms, 75 ms over the floor. The monitor tab exists only in the right view and the maintenance tab only in the left one.
view.monitor: The camera monitor is a toggle on one tab: pressed once it rises over the office (the camera map with Play Audio and Map Toggle), pressed again it drops. Map Toggle swaps the camera map (CAM 01-10, Play Audio) for the vent map (CAM 11-15, a seal bar beside each); the selected label turns green.
view.seal: On the vent map two touch-starts on a vent label within ~30 frames arm its seal (g632 adds 30 per touch, g635 fires above 30); a second press seconds later does nothing. The mobile charge lasts 100 + Random(100) frames (g635) and is cancelled if the map toggles or the monitor drops (g584, g585). The seal bar beside the vent turns red when it commits.

loadGame.effect: LOAD GAME: the office within 4 s (f3-ex1 0002)

panRight.effect: office panned right, the monitor tab in view (f3-ex1 0006)

panLeft.effect: office panned left, the maintenance tab in view (f3-ex1 0023)

playAudio.effect: Play Audio at the selected camera
